name: Luxor Tours to Kharga and Dakhla Oases
description: Unleash your inner adventurer and enjoy amazing Luxor Tours to Kharga and Dakhla Oases with Ibis Egypt Tours. Experience our unique Desert Safari tours to valuable attractions of Kharga Oasis and feast your Soul with beauty of Dakhla Oasis with many Chances to taste the beauty of our Safari Desert Trip through memorable Sightseeing Tours, Camping and more.

highlights: Luxor to Kharga Oasis – Dakhla Oasis

itinerary.title: Luxor to Kharga Oasis – Dakhla Oasis
itinerary.description: Ibis Egypt Tours representative will Pick up from your hotel in Luxor at 5:30 A.M, Drive by Four-wheel Jeep to Kharga Oases, driving around 350-KM, Lunch will be served on route, then start your tour to Temple of Hibis& Nadora ( Outside Visiting ) , then proceed to El Bagawat Cemetery which was early Christian Cemetery . At the end of your tour transfer to Dakhla Oasis and enjoy amazing time at a marvelous Dakhla Oasis style hut with communal showers and basic facilities . Dinner and overnight in Dakhla Oasis. Meals: Lunch, Dinner

itinerary.title: Dakhla Oasis to Kharga Oasis
itinerary.description: Enjoy your tasty breakfast, and then start an amazing adventure tour to visit The Roman Temple of Deir El Hagar, Proceed to visit Muzzawaka. Then you will have amazing tour to Islamic Village of Al Qasr then about 35km from Mut houses ruins of Ayubid mosque. Then transfer to Kharga Oasis and enjoy Overnight Camping in Kharga Oasis. Meals: Breakfast, Lunch, Dinner

itinerary.title: Kharga Oasis to Luxor
itinerary.description: Enjoy your tasty breakfast at your Camp and finally Ibis Egypt Tours guide will escort you back to your hotel in Luxor. In Luxor you will find many things to do through our unique Luxor tours if you want to add more adventures to your itinerary.

inclusions: Expert English speaking representative will Pick you up from your hotel in Luxor
01 night at Dakhla Oasis Style Hut, Dehoos Lodge on half board basis.
Camping for 01 Night in Kharga on Full board basis including equipments , Sleeping bags and tents including breakfast and dinner
03 Days Professional English Speaking tour Guide
Entrance Fees at the above mentioned sites mentioned at the above itinerary
Permissions required for the Safari desert adventure tour
Three bottles of mineral water per person per day
One soft drink per person per day
Salty and Sweaty snacks are available in your jeep
Drive back to your hotel in Luxor
exclusions: Personal expenses or any extras at the hotels or during the tour
Meals except where included in the itinerary.
